svg.title: NexaCart logo concept: N-and-dot mark with wordmark
svg.desc: Owner-approved N-and-dot concept direction. One continuous N-shaped path followed by a dot stands for a single clear route to arrival. Wordmark uses the approved Geist typeface as live text in this concept sheet. Not final production artwork; prepare outlined artwork separately.

text.font-family: Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Primary lockup, ink on white. Dot in accent cobalt #2447D6.

text.font-family: Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Reversed on ink. Dot lightened to #8FA6FF for contrast.
Mark alone at 48, 32, 24 and 16 px (header, tab, favicon, app badge). Keep clear space equal to the dot diameter on all sides. Minimum size 16 px.
